Who We Are

Building Industrial Futures in Greater Noida

The Estate Empire is Greater Noida's premier industrial property consultancy. Located in the heart of the MSX Tower-1 Commercial Belt, we specialize in industrial plots — helping businesses find, secure, and build their industrial presence with zero hassle and maximum value.

From sale and rent to fresh liaising and full construction management, we handle every step so you don't have to.

What We Do

Our Services

01
Industrial Plot Sales

Premium industrial plots across Greater Noida's commercial and industrial belts, tailored to your scale and sector.

02
Industrial Plot Rentals

Flexible rental solutions for industrial spaces — short and long-term arrangements negotiated on your behalf.

03
Fresh Liaising

End-to-end government and authority liaising for new industrial projects — approvals, clearances, and documentation handled seamlessly.

04
Fresh Construction

Complete industrial construction from ground-up — factory sheds, warehouses, and custom industrial structures built to spec.

05
Residential Plot Sales

Premium residential plots across Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta and ETA sectors in Greater Noida — helping families find their perfect home.
